source: https://runescape.wiki/w/Deathtouched_dart (CC BY-NC-SA 3.0), read 2026-11-11; names as the drop tables spell them
removal: the wiki says the dart is scheduled for removal on 23 November 2026 with the other MTX items
rules: a dart kill doesn't count in the Beasts tab (so not for boss kill-count achievements, Soul Reaper or fastest kills), awards no Marks of War and no combat xp (Slayer xp still), and starts a 15-minute penalty during which other boss kills aren't recorded either
drops from a dart kill do count for boss collection logs; augmented items gain item xp as normal
in a group no one gets kill count when any player darts the boss

immune_notes.TzKal-Zuk: the minions can be darted, Zuk himself not
immune_notes.Blood nihil: they recover and heal their allies

partial.Telos, the Warden: clears one phase only, whatever the enrage (the 100% trimmed-comp kill still counts)
partial.Seiryu the Azure Serpent: only collapses Seiryu: the black crystals still have to be destroyed (they can be darted too)
partial.Araxxor: the first dart kills all three Araxxor phases, a second one Araxxi
partial.Har-Aken: must be thrown at the head, not a tentacle

achievements_unlocked.Nex: works on Nex (not Nex, Angel of Death); use Anticipation or Freedom before she is attackable
